rules.name: No Mixed Assignments in Always
rules.description: Do not mix blocking (=) and non-blocking (<=) assignments inside the same always block to prevent simulation/synthesis race conditions.

rules.name: Correct Assignment Operator by Always Type
rules.description: Use non-blocking assignments (<=) for sequential always blocks and blocking assignments (=) for combinational always @(*) blocks.

rules.name: Case Default Clause Required
rules.description: Always specify a 'default' clause in 'case' statements to prevent latch inference and cover undefined states.

rules.name: Clock and Reset Naming Conventions
rules.description: Follow STARC naming conventions for clock signals (prefix 'clk') and active-low reset signals (suffix '_n').

rules.name: Named Port Connections in Submodules
rules.description: Prohibit positional port connections in submodule instances; all port connections must be explicit and named: .port_name(net_name).

rules.name: Module Name Matches File Name
rules.description: The module name must match the base name of the Verilog source file (.v or .vh).

rules.name: Single Module per File
rules.description: Define only one module per file to maintain modularity and reusability (STARC/RMM).

rules.name: Parameter Naming Conventions
rules.description: Follow STARC naming conventions for parameters and localparams (uppercase with underscores: ^[A-Z0-9_]+$).

rules.name: Incomplete Combinational Sensitivity List
rules.description: Combinational always blocks must list all read signals in their sensitivity list (or use @*) to prevent simulation-synthesis mismatches.

rules.name: Bus Bit-Width Mismatch
rules.description: Detect bit-width mismatches between left-hand side and right-hand side in continuous and procedural assignments according to IEEE 1364.

rules.name: Unconnected Ports in Submodule Instances
rules.description: Warn about unconnected submodule input ports (floating inputs) and inform about unconnected output ports.

rules.name: No Inferred Latch in Combinational Logic
rules.description: Avoid incomplete conditional branches in always @(*) blocks (such as if without else) that infer unwanted hardware latches.
